fee_notes: Fee varies by franchisee status and number of existing units: $30,000 for new franchisees opening a Freestanding, Endcap, or Non-Traditional Restaurant; $19,500 for existing franchisees (as of March 31, 2026) in good standing with one operational Freestanding or Endcap Restaurant opening their second; $15,000 for existing franchisees (as of March 31, 2026) in good standing with two or more operational units opening another. Under a Development Agreement for 3 restaurants, fees are $25,000 (1st), $15,000 (2nd), and $12,500 (3rd), paid as a lump sum of $52,500. Veterans qualifying under the 2026 Veterans Incentive Program pay a reduced fee of $21,000 (down from $30,000) for a new Freestanding or Endcap Restaurant. A refund of up to 50% may apply if a site cannot be agreed upon within 12 months; up to 20% if Construction Approval is not obtained within 18 months. In FY2025, no franchisee received a reduction in the initial franchise fee.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee is $30,000 for a new franchisee that is opening a Freestanding Restaurant, Endcap Restaurant or Non-Traditional Restaurant, $19,500 for an existing franchisee as of March 31, 2026 that is in good standing (i.e., not in default of any agreement the franchisee entered into with A&W or any affiliate), already has one operational Freestanding Restaurant or Endcap Restaurant, and is opening its second Freestanding Restaurant, Endcap Restaurant or Non-Traditional Restaurant, and $15,000 for an existing franchisee as of March 31, 2026 that is in good standing, already has two or more operational Freestanding Restaurants and/or Endcap Restaurants and/or Non-Traditional Restaurants, and is opening another Freestanding Restaurant, Endcap Restaurant or Non-Traditional Restaurant.
